primarySource.title: LEGO 7314 Recon-Mech RP building instructions
findings: The completed two-leg walker is shown on printed page 30.
Printed pages 31-34 show the upper craft and lower leg module manually separated, rotated and reconnected into a flight configuration.
The walker has a broad open cockpit body, one black claw arm, one long red arm ending in a dark disc and orange flame-shaped element, twin legs with broad feet, hoses and a raised rear tank assembly.

productionTarget.role: Official completed-model photograph, framed from printed page 30; source pixels retained without retouching.

secondaryEvidence.title: Eurobricks completed model review
secondaryEvidence.use: Secondary confirmation of source arm placement and rear/tank relationship; official LEGO instructions remain primary.

secondaryEvidence.title: The Rambling Brick: 7314 completed-model comparative review

evidenceDistinction.directlyShown: Finished walker and documented manually rebuilt flight configuration in the official LEGO instructions.
evidenceDistinction.crossSourceInference: Relative arm identity: from the model's forward direction, the black claw is on its left and the long red flame-shaped projector arm is on its right; checked against the official instructions and completed front-facing collector photo.
unresolved: The official source does not show a walking gait or sensor/anti-air tracking cycle.

The T082 packet calls the long arm a drill/lance; completed source photos and independent reviews instead identify its visible orange flame-shaped end as a flame projector. The T083 target retains the source geometry and does not add new tracking parts.
evidenceDistinction.adaptations: No visible geometry adaptation. The canonical detection/anti-air function is an in-game use of the retained source appearance, not evidence for added geometry.
